title: [Main]-Adjust Cost creates an additional unexpected variance amount due to rounding precision during cost adjustment.
summary: Cost adjustment for assembly items now uses unit-amount rounding precision instead of general ledger setup precision, eliminating unexpected variance amounts from rounding differences.
key_points: During cost adjustment, cost shares are now rounded with unit-amount precision (0.00001) instead of the G/L Setup amount rounding precision
Removes an unexpected extra variance that rounding created during cost adjustment of assembly items
The Inventory Adjustment codeunit is changed in the W1, APAC and RU layers, and the Asm. Inventory Adjmt. Entry table extension in W1
Adds a regression test to SCM Costing Bugs II
quote: GetUnitCostsFromItem() rounds the cost shares using Unit-Amount Rounding Precision (0.00001).
